inclusions: Dedicated AC Cab with driver
All toll, fuel, and driver allowances
tourism_packages.subtitle: Grand Trunk Road & Ancient Afghan Architecture
tourism_packages.title: Sasaram Sher Shah Suri Tomb Heritage Tour

inclusions: Dedicated AC Cab with driver
All toll, fuel, and driver allowances
tourism_packages.subtitle: Grand Trunk Road & Ancient Afghan Architecture
tourism_packages.title: Sasaram Sher Shah Suri Tomb Heritage Tour

tourism_packages.description: Visit the historic land of the Lichhavi Republic where Lord Buddha preached his last sermon. See the monolithic Ashokan Lion Pillar, Buddha Relic Stupa, and the world's tallest Kesaria Stupa.
inclusions: Dedicated roundtrip AC cab
All highway tolls, bridge tolls, and fuel
Driver allowance included
tourism_packages.subtitle: Ashoka Lion Pillar, Buddha Relic Stupa & World's Tallest Stupa
tourism_packages.title: Vaishali & Kesaria Buddhist Stupa Tour

tourism_packages.description: Immerse yourself in Bihar's crown eco-tourism destination. Dense Himalayan foothills, Royal Bengal tigers, wild elephants, jungle safaris, and pristine Gandak river boat rides.
exclusions: Forest Department jungle safari jeep permits
inclusions: Roundtrip intercity AC cab with experienced hill/forest driver
All fuel, state border taxes, toll plaza fees
Driver night halt allowances
tourism_packages.subtitle: West Champaran Wilderness & Gandak River Ghats
tourism_packages.title: Valmiki Tiger Reserve & Eco-Safari Tour

tourism_packages.description: Delve into the vibrant cultural heart of Mithila. Visit majestic Darbhanga Raj Palaces (Anand Bagh & Nargona), live Madhubani painting villages (Jitwarpur & Ranti), and ancient Maithil heritage sites.
inclusions: AC Cab with dedicated driver for 2 days
All fuel, tolls, and driver overnight allowances
Doorstep pickup and drop
tourism_packages.subtitle: Darbhanga Raj Palaces, Ranti Art Village & Janakpur
tourism_packages.title: Mithila Heritage & Madhubani Art Circuit

tourism_packages.description: Explore the ancient cradle of Buddhism and learning. Journey to Vishwa Shanti Stupa via ropeway, the ruins of Nalanda World University, Griddhakuta Peak, and the holy Jal Mandir at Pawapuri.
inclusions: Dedicated AC Cab with verified driver
All fuel, highway toll charges, and driver allowance
Sightseeing at Nalanda, Rajgir, and Pawapuri
tourism_packages.subtitle: Vishwa Shanti Stupa, Venuvana & Nalanda Ruins
tourism_packages.title: Rajgir & Nalanda Ancient University Circuit

tourism_packages.description: Experience the rich historical tapestry of ancient Pataliputra. Visit the holy Takht Sri Patna Sahib Gurudwara (birthplace of Guru Gobind Singh Ji), the architectural marvel Bihar Museum, and historic Golghar.
inclusions: AC Cab with commercial driver
8 hours & 80 km local sightseeing allowance
Fuel & driver allowance included
tourism_packages.subtitle: Takht Sri Patna Sahib, Bihar Museum & Golghar
tourism_packages.title: Patna Sahib & Capital Heritage Excursion

tourism_packages.description: Complete spiritual pilgrimage covering UNESCO World Heritage Mahabodhi Temple, the sacred Bodhi Tree, Vishnupad Temple, Mangla Gauri Shaktipeeth, and sacred Falgu River pind daan sites.
inclusions: AC Cab with dedicated driver for 2 days
All fuel, toll tax, and state permits
Driver night allowance & parking fees
Pickup & drop within municipal limits
tourism_packages.subtitle: UNESCO Mahabodhi Temple, Falgu River & Vishnupad Darshan
tourism_packages.title: Bodh Gaya & Gaya Spiritual Heritage Tour
